methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the title and connection state of the explored object. Used on first open and when reconnecting to an existing comm.

schema.name: object_explorer_state
schema.description: The state of an object explorer

title.description: Title for the editor tab, usually the variable name or expression that was viewed

connected.description: False when the explored object no longer exists; the frontend shows a disconnected state

error_message.description: Optional message explaining why the explorer is disconnected

methods.name: get_root
methods.description: Returns the node describing the explored object itself (path []).

methods.name: get_children
methods.summary: Get one page of a node's children
methods.description: Returns up to 'limit' children of the node at 'path', starting at child index 'start'. Never descends more than one level.

params.name: path
params.description: Access keys from the root to the parent node; [] is the root

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based index of the first child to return

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of children to return

children.description: The requested page of children, in the object's natural order

total.description: Total number of children the parent has (may exceed the number returned)

methods.name: search
methods.description: Depth-first, case-insensitive substring search over node display names, and over the display values of leaves (nodes that are neither containers nor cycles), bounded by max_depth and an internal node budget. Returns matches and every ancestor of a match, in pre-order, so the frontend can render the results as a tree.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Maximum depth below the root to descend (root children are depth 1)

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum number of matching nodes to return

rows.description: Matches and their ancestors in pre-order

truncated.description: True if the search stopped early because max_results or the node budget was reached

methods.name: format_value
methods.summary: Format a node's full value for the clipboard
methods.description: Returns the complete (untruncated, within reason) plain-text representation of the node at 'path'.

params.name: path
params.description: Access keys from the root to the node

schema.name: formatted_value
schema.description: A value formatted for the clipboard

methods.name: open_object_explorer
methods.summary: Open a full object explorer for an inline explorer
methods.description: Asks the backend to open a new, non-inline object explorer comm on the same object. Returns the new comm id.

schema.description: The comm id of the newly opened object explorer

object_node.description: One node in the explored object

access_key.description: The path segment that selects this node within its parent; same semantics as the variables comm

display_name.description: The node's name (key, index, slot, or attribute), formatted for display

display_type.description: The node's type, formatted for display using the same formatter as the variables comm

display_value.description: The node's value, formatted for display and possibly truncated, using the same formatter as the variables comm

kind.description: The kind of value, using the same vocabulary as the variables comm

length.description: The number of children or elements, if known; 0 otherwise

has_children.description: Whether get_children would return anything for this node

is_truncated.description: True if display_value is a truncated representation

is_cycle.description: True if this node is the same object as one of its ancestors; such nodes never report children

accessor.description: A language expression that evaluates to this node's value. Absent when no expression exists.

search_row.description: A row in a search result: a match or an ancestor of a match

path.description: Access keys from the root to this node

match_kind.description: Which field matched; 'ancestor' for ancestors included only for context
